recipes.title: Fajita-Style Freezer Marinade
recipes.summary: Made with boneless skinless chicken, bell pepper and onion.
ingredients: 300 g boneless skinless chicken, sliced into strips
100 g mushrooms, sliced and dry-sautéed 3–4 minutes until the water cooks off (cool before bagging)
1 tbsp + 1/2 tsp olive oil, juice of 1/2 lime, 3/4 tsp hot chili powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, pinch of dried oregano, salt to taste
method: Toss the chicken strips with all marinade ingredients; rest 30 minutes in the fridge.
Transfer to a freezer bag, squeeze out the air, lay flat, label with the date; freeze up to 3 months.
Thaw overnight in the fridge (it keeps marinating as it thaws — never on the counter).
Sear the chicken strips with the peppers, onion and mushrooms from the bag in a screaming-hot pan 6–8 minutes until cooked through. Serve in wraps or bowls.

recipes.title: Lemon-Garlic Herb Freezer Marinade
recipes.summary: Made with boneless skinless chicken thighs, bell pepper and yellow onion.
ingredients: 100 g mushrooms, sliced and dry-sautéed 3–4 minutes until the water cooks off (cool before bagging)
2 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1/2 lemon, 2 garlic cloves, minced, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, scant 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, pinch of chili flakes (optional)
2–3 tbsp cottage cheese, blended smooth (optional, for a creamy version)
method: Toss the chicken with all marinade ingredients; rest 30 minutes in the fridge.
Transfer to a freezer bag, squeeze out the air, lay flat, label with the date; freeze up to 3 months.
Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, or grill, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
